verdict.rationale: Ernd is a business card offering rewards on AI-vendor spend. A card or spend-management product could plausibly offer bulk actions such as issuing many cards or recategorizing many transactions, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers reward rates, card requests and withdrawing a request, with nothing on bulk or multi-item operations. The API probes hit developers.google.com rather than ernd and say nothing about this capability.
